Possible Cause:
RPFS SBC at SCD
Rack due to improper
shutting down or
starting of SBCs or
RFPS/SCD Application
Corrective action:
SCD Display is established.
Shutdown both RFPS and
SCD SBCs at SCD Rack and
Power ON for proper
establishment of Synergy
Link.

Possible Cause:
Invalid data might have
been processed by
DSP.
Corrective action:
Re-capture data in RFPS
Application. If issue persists,
shut down RFPS Processor
Chassis and Power ON.

Possible Cause:
Invalid data might have
been acquired by DAU
Corrective action:
Re-capture data in RFPS
Application. If issue persists,
shut down RFPS Processor
Chassis and Power ON.

Possible Cause:
RF/IF Path may be
faulty or IF Attenuation
and Threshold settings
are not appropriate for
present signal.
Corrective action:
Check corresponding
parameters’ tracks are
available in SCD Display.

Check proper settings for
IF/RF Attenuation.

Monitor RF in Spectrum
analyzer at RFPS Chassis
LRU input. Repair/ Replace
corresponding component
for which output is not
available.

Check RF and IF path to be
error free to deliver IF for
RFPS
